column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a wise man is in strength” is rendered “A wise man is strong.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּתְשׁוּעָה (“victory”) is rendered “safety.”
Close to the Hebrew; “master of plots” is rendered “a schemer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your strength is narrow” is rendered “Your strength is small.”
Close to the Hebrew; “if you will restrain” is rendered “hold back.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַחֲרִית (“a future”) is rendered “a prospect.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will stumble in calamity” is rendered “shall fall by calamity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who change” is rendered “those given to change.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to regard the face” is rendered “to show partiality.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “the wicked.”
